verdict.rationale: Drata documents a public REST API v2 with OAuth setup and broad CRUD endpoints for controls, monitoring tests, the evidence library, policies and custom connections. It also says it can automate evidence collection and compliance workflows with custom triggers, so a script can drive the product without its UI. However, nothing shows a CLI, a CI integration (such as a pipeline action or plugin), or guidance for running it in CI, so the headless/CI story rests only on the API surface. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration, documented CI/headless usage patterns, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
